# 1. Data orchestration and analysis

\*\*\* Under development \*\*\*

Outline. This step happens in OpenHEXA: getting routine and global data in, checking and cleaning it, and computing the SNT indicators.

1. Which data are needed, and in which format (routine, pyramid, boundaries, population, surveys)
2. Setting up the country: pyramid, admin level of analysis, indicator mapping
3. Extracting data from DHIS2 or the NMDR
4. Checking data: what the pipeline reports show (completeness, reporting rates, outliers)
5. Cleaning data: choosing the outlier and reporting-rate methods
6. Computing indicators: population, incidence, seasonality, DHS, MAP, ERA5, access to care
7. Scheduling pipelines
8. Changing or adding a pipeline with an AI assistant, or from RStudio
9. Sending results to SNT Explorer&#32;
10. Sending processed data back to the NMDR
